# zjsonpatch 2026.07.02

- [This is an implementation of [RFC 6902 JSON Patch](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6902) written in Java with extended JSON pointer.](https://github.com/flipkart-incubator/zjsonpatch/blob/master/README.md)
